title: Interpretable Singing Emotion Recognition Using Acoustic and Vocal Technique Features
abstract: arXiv:2610.32629v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Singing emotion recognition relies predominantly on deep learning models that achieve strong performance but offer limited insight into the vocal characteristics driving emotion, of- ten overlooking the singing voice as a distinct signal. We propose an interpretable singing emotion recognition framework using a compact set of singing-specific descriptors across prosody, spec- tral features, phonetics, and vocal technique. To decode model decisions and link predictions to measurable acoustic phenomena, we employ SHAP and apply GRAD-CAM to qualitatively assess the learned representations of vocal techniques. Evaluations show that singing-specific features reduce cross-singer variability, while vocal technique descriptors provide interpretable insights into singing expression. translated_title: 使用声学与声乐技巧特征的可解释歌唱情感识别
translated_abstract: 歌唱情感识别主要依赖于深度学习模型，这些模型虽然性能强劲，但对驱动情感的声乐特征提供的洞察有限，且常常忽视歌声作为一种独特信号的价值。我们提出一个可解释的歌唱情感识别框架，使用一组精简的歌唱专用描述子，涵盖韵律、频谱特征、语音学和声乐技巧等方面。为了解码模型决策并将预测与可测量的声学现象联系起来，我们采用SHAP方法，并应用GRAD-CAM来定性地评估模型学习到的声乐技巧表征。评估结果表明，歌唱专用特征能够降低跨歌手的差异性，而声乐技巧描述子则为歌唱表达提供了可解释的洞察。此外，在VocalSet数据集上的域外评估揭示了情感表达与真实技巧执行之间的有趣关联。该分析……
tldr: 该论文提出一个使用歌唱专用声学与声乐技巧特征的可解释歌唱情感识别框架，借助SHAP和GRAD-CAM揭示情感表达与声乐技巧执行之间的关联。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an interpretable singing emotion recognition framework using a compact set of singing-specific acoustic and vocal technique features, leveraging SHAP and GRAD-CAM to reveal associations between emotional expression and vocal technique execution.
